headline: As of 2026-10-18: 9,089,899 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 39 of 50 states, D+19.4 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 9,089,899 early/mail ballots cast so far across 39 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+19.4 by registration.
Most ballots cast: California (1,308,140), Georgia (837,439), Florida (833,483).
